reconcile.note: Clarke reads Ezekiel's pride and neglect-of-the-poor charges as additional causes layered onto Sodom's sexual sin, not a rival account of the city's ruin.

discrepancy.emptyNote: John Boswell argued that the biblical tradition, including Ezekiel's own gloss, identifies Sodom's sin as inhospitality rather than homosexual conduct.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: John Boswell (1980), Christianity, Social Tolerance, and Homosexuality.

sides.snippet: Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.
sides.verseText: They called to Lot, and said to him, \"Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.\"

sides.snippet: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters; neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
sides.verseText: Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters; neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
